OLBG does not show bookmaker prices to this location
flags.detail: Every event card rendered 'WIN @' with an empty price slot and every event page rendered the market without a decimal or fractional price. Tip counts, the tipped selection and the tip share did render. No OLBG price is therefore quoted anywhere on this desk; every price published here is one this desk originated and is labelled as such.

flags.title: OLBG's rendered clock runs seven minutes ahead of the official UTC conversion
flags.detail: NHL game 2026020182 starts 2026-10-25T23:00:00Z, which is 19:00 US Eastern, and OLBG printed 'Tomorrow 19:07'. The same +7 minute offset appears on all twenty NHL rows checked. No OLBG clock string is used as a start time; the official feed is used where one was read.

flags.title: Nine handball rows show 'Tie' as the most-tipped selection
flags.detail: On the handball hub the modal selection is 'Tie' on nine rows, several at 100% of a small sample (7/7, 4/4, 3/3). A drawn handball match is uncommon, so a 'Tie' row carrying every tip is more likely a rendering of the draw leg of a three-way market than a genuine crowd position. Those rows are published as listed but are not used to originate a price.

flags.title: Fourteen tennis rows carry an OLBG start time but no official confirmation
flags.detail: The ATP scores page returned only page chrome and no draw, and the WTA draw pages were not read. Fixture, players and OLBG's clock are recorded; the official start time and the tournament name are left blank on every tennis row rather than guessed.

flags.title: Thirteen sports carry no governing-body statistics in this capture
flags.detail: Only the five NHL fixtures have league totals read from an official feed. For every other fixture the win price is a normalised read of the tip share OLBG itself publishes, and only the win market is originated, because a handicap or a total cannot be derived without scoring data. Those rows are graded no higher than medium however short the price.

flags.title: League sites that returned no table to this reader
flags.detail: Lega Pallavolo's classifica page returned navigation only (the table is rendered client-side), and the Handball-Bundesliga table URL redirected to a 404 page. Volleyball and handball therefore stay on tier B.

flags.detail: The MLB schedule feed returns totalGames 0 for 2026-10-25. The only baseball row OLBG lists is TB @ MIL, which starts 2026-10-25T00:00:00Z.
